sources.title: Google’s patent for custom AI video feeds paints a bleak picture of entertainment’s future

cards.summary: Last year, Google filed a patent for a system called My Channel that's designed to create feeds filled with personalized, AI-generated videos and advertisements based on information the company knows about its users. The patent has been rejected, but unfortunately, Google might appeal or resubmit an amended version, and we could see this monstrosity come to market.

sources.title: Amazon is reportedly in talks to end Muse AI shopping block

cards.summary: The discussions, which could end Amazon's block on Muse , reportedly center on the kinds of products the AI agent recommends and the potential impact on the ecommerce giant's advertising revenue. As reported by Fortune , Amazon is concerned that it could lose advertising revenue by allowing Muse on its site, since it depends on actual humans seeing ads across its online marketplace.
cards.title: Amazon is reportedly in talks to end Muse AI shopping block
